themes.title: Populist Economic Relief Promises and Tax Cuts Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple nations are highlighting direct financial relief, tax cuts, and economic benefits to appeal to voters facing high living costs. In Norway, FrP continues to advocate for fuel tax reductions, while in the US, MAGA leadership promotes direct dividend proposals and agricultural tax credits.

themes.title: Right-Wing Mainstreaming and Power Consolidation Ahead of Key Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements are actively institutionalizing their influence by expanding into local races and amassing major financial capital. From Reform UK securing massive donor backing in Britain to MAGA candidates challenging nonpartisan local school offices in the US, right-wing forces are seeking to entrench power.

countries.note: Secures record £72m in donations to build institutional power and challenge mainstream parties

themes.title: Electoral Volatility and Internal Friction Facing Right-Wing Parties
themes.blurb: Populist and right-wing parties are confronting political headwinds, voter dissatisfaction, and organizational friction across European nations. In Sweden, SD suffers widespread municipal polling losses tied to party turbulence, while Reform UK struggles to turn massive fundraising into immediate political dominance.
